caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned flat iron placed centrally on a light beige background. The iron has a heavy, solid-looking triangular metal base rendered in shades of brown and rusty gold, showing areas of wear and dark discoloration. Two vertical pillars or supports, colored in a similar gold-brown tone, rise from the base and hold a cylindrical, dark wooden handle with lighter brown grain lines and small metallic end caps. There is an additional metal component extending vertically at the right end of the handle, featuring a round, coiled element. At the lower center of the paper, beneath the iron, the name "George Roehl 38." is handwritten in gray pencil or ink. The composition is simple, with the iron as the sole object against an unadorned background.
title: Flatiron
